blocks.text: Production deployments require QA sign-off on a successful staging run and a Security scan with no critical findings before deployment may proceed. QA review and the Security scan run in parallel.
Confirmation of on-call engineer availability is required before any production deployment. The deployment must occur within the approved change window.
If the Security scan identifies a critical finding, the deployment is blocked until the finding is remediated and a clean scan result is obtained.
If a deployment fails, the on-call engineer must execute the rollback procedure within 30 minutes of the failure being declared.

messages.text: Heads up: the rollback window has been reduced to 15 minutes for Tier 1 services, effective with the next release cycle. Non-Tier-1 services remain at 30 minutes.
